body.statement:
For each \(\varepsilon>0\) there is a constant \(C>0\) such that, whenever \(d_n\ge C\log n\), there are graphs \(G_*\) and \(G^*\) coupled with \(G_n\) such that \(G_*\sim G(n,(1-\varepsilon)d_n/n)\), \(G^*\sim G(n,(1+\varepsilon)d_n/n)\), and
\[
\Pr\{G_*\subseteq G\subseteq G^*\}=1-o(1).
\]

source.verbatim_statement: For each \(\varepsilon>0\) there is some \(C>0\) such that the following holds for each \(d\ge C\log n\). There is a coupling \((G_*,G,G^*)\) of random graphs such that \(G_*\sim G(n,(1-\varepsilon)d/n)\), \(G\sim G_d(n)\), \(G^*\sim G(n,(1+\varepsilon)d/n)\), and \(\mathbb P(G_*\subset G\subset G^*)=1-o(1)\).
